title: The cardinality annihilates an abstract finite additive group
statement: Let $H$ be a finite additive group, meaning a finite set with an associative addition, a zero element and additive inverses. For every $h\in H$ one has $|H|h=0$, where $|H|$ is the cardinality of the finite underlying set [def-sfb-finite-infinite-set] and $mh$ denotes adding $h$ to itself $m$ times. Commutativity is not required.
